method: Each labeled PNG was opened from the formal root at original resolution. Same-frame STATIC and MOTION_AWARE images were compared for subject readability, helmet and shoulder boundary retention, background breathing room and visible regressions.

pairObservations.observation: The pair is visually near-identical at the smooth path start; no visible regression.
Only a marginal increase in breathing room; no visible regression.
MOTION_AWARE is subtly wider and preserves slightly more background and shoulder boundary.
The wider motion-aware framing becomes clearly visible while maintaining the intended close-shot emphasis.
MOTION_AWARE retains more helmet perimeter, shoulder and negative space than STATIC.
STATIC is visibly tightening; MOTION_AWARE preserves subject-context balance.
The difference is strong: MOTION_AWARE materially reduces crowding without changing subject or angle.
Decisive control failure: STATIC is visibly over-tight, while MOTION_AWARE retains helmet, shoulder and background breathing room.

nonClaims: This review does not claim cinematic storytelling, final-film photorealism, final color grading or full-sequence temporal stability.
The stylized low-detail subject and 16-spp diagnostic softness are not representative of the target final asset and render quality.
Labeled engineering review is not blind preference evidence.
